+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TextIO
+
+from app.notes import Note, NoteError, NotesStore
+
+DEFAULT_PATH = Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+ENV_VAR = "NOTES_FILE"
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="notes", description="A tiny command-line notes app."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        default=None,
+        help=f"path to the notes file (default: ${ENV_VAR} or {DEFAULT_PATH})",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a new note")
+    p_add.add_argument("text", nargs="+", help="note text")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p_show = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note by id")
+    p_show.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note by id")
+    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_search = sub.add_parser("search", help="find notes containing text")
+    p_search.add_argument("query", nargs="+")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def resolve_path(cli_value: str | None) -> Path:
+    if cli_value:
+        return Path(cli_value).expanduser()
+    env = os.environ.get(ENV_VAR)
+    if env:
+        return Path(env).expanduser()
+    return DEFAULT_PATH
+
+
+def _format_note(note: Note) -> str:
+    return f"[{note.id}] {note.created}  {note.text}"
+
+
+def _print_notes(notes: Sequence[Note], out: TextIO) -> None:
+    if not notes:
+        print("No notes.", file=out)
+        return
+    for note in notes:
+        print(_format_note(note), file=out)
+
+
+def main(
+    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
+    *,
+    out: TextIO | None = None,
+    err: TextIO | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    out = out if out is not None else sys.stdout
+    err = err if err is not None else sys.stderr
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
+    store = NotesStore(resolve_path(args.file))
+
+    try:
+        if args.command == "add":
+            note = store.add(" ".join(args.text))
+            print(f"Added note {note.id}.", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "list":
+            _print_notes(store.list(), out)
+        elif args.command == "show":
+            print(_format_note(store.get(args.id)), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "delete":
+            note = store.delete(args.id)
+            print(f"Deleted note {note.id}.", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "search":
+            _print_notes(store.search(" ".join(args.query)), out)
+    except NoteError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Storage layer for notes, backed by a JSON file."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteError(Exception):
+    """Raised for invalid note operations (e.g. unknown id)."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    text: str
+    created: str  # ISO 8601, UTC
+
+
+class NotesStore:
+    """A collection of notes persisted to a single JSON file."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        # Write atomically so a crash never leaves a half-written file.
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump([asdict(n) for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.unlink(tmp)
+            raise
+
+    def add(self, text: str) -> Note:
+        text = text.strip()
+        if not text:
+            raise NoteError("note text must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        note = Note(
+            id=next_id,
+            text=text,
+            created=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
+        )
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def list(self) -> list[Note]:
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteError(f"no note with id {note_id}")
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        notes = self._load()
+        for i, note in enumerate(notes):
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                del notes[i]
+                self._save(notes)
+                return note
+        raise NoteError(f"no note with id {note_id}")
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        needle = query.casefold()
+        return [n for n in self.list() if needle in n.text.casefold()]

+import io
+
+import pytest
+
+from app.cli import main
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def notes_file(tmp_path):
+    return str(tmp_path / "notes.json")
+
+
+def run(args, notes_file):
+    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
+    code = main(["--file", notes_file, *args], out=out, err=err)
+    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()
+
+
+def test_add_and_list(notes_file):
+    code, out, _ = run(["add", "buy", "milk"], notes_file)
+    assert code == 0
+    assert out == "Added note 1.\n"
+
+    code, out, _ = run(["list"], notes_file)
+    assert code == 0
+    assert "[1]" in out and "buy milk" in out
+
+
+def test_list_empty(notes_file):
+    code, out, _ = run(["list"], notes_file)
+    assert code == 0
+    assert out == "No notes.\n"
+
+
+def test_show(notes_file):
+    run(["add", "hello"], notes_file)
+    code, out, _ = run(["show", "1"], notes_file)
+    assert code == 0
+    assert "[1]" in out and out.rstrip().endswith("hello")
+
+
+def test_show_missing_reports_error(notes_file):
+    code, out, err = run(["show", "7"], notes_file)
+    assert code == 1
+    assert out == ""
+    assert err == "error: no note with id 7\n"
+
+
+def test_delete(notes_file):
+    run(["add", "bye"], notes_file)
+    code, out, _ = run(["delete", "1"], notes_file)
+    assert code == 0
+    assert out == "Deleted note 1.\n"
+    assert run(["list"], notes_file)[1] == "No notes.\n"
+
+
+def test_delete_missing_reports_error(notes_file):
+    code, _, err = run(["delete", "3"], notes_file)
+    assert code == 1
+    assert "no note with id 3" in err
+
+
+def test_search(notes_file):
+    run(["add", "groceries", "eggs"], notes_file)
+    run(["add", "work stuff"], notes_file)
+    code, out, _ = run(["search", "EGGS"], notes_file)
+    assert code == 0
+    assert "groceries eggs" in out
+    assert "work stuff" not in out
+
+
+def test_add_with_blank_text_fails(notes_file):
+    code, _, err = run(["add", " ", " "], notes_file)
+    assert code == 1
+    assert "must not be empty" in err
+

+    assert main(["add", "via env"], out=out) == 0
+    assert path.exists()
+
+
+def test_missing_command_exits_with_usage_error(notes_file):

+        run([], notes_file)

+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TextIO
+
+from app.store import Note, NoteNotFoundError, NoteStore
+
+DEFAULT_PATH = Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+
+
+def default_store_path() -> Path:
+    """Return NOTES_FILE if set, otherwise ~/.notes.json."""
+    env = os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE")
+    return Path(env) if env else DEFAULT_PATH
+
+
+def _format_note(note: Note, full: bool = False) -> str:
+    if not full:
+        return f"{note.id:>4}  {note.title}"
+    lines = [
+        f"id:      {note.id}",
+        f"title:   {note.title}",
+        f"created: {note.created}",
+        f"updated: {note.updated}",
+        "",
+        note.body,
+    ]
+    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip()
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="notes", description="A tiny command-line notes app."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help="path to the notes file (default: $NOTES_FILE or ~/.notes.json)",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a new note")
+    p.add_argument("title")
+    p.add_argument("-b", "--body", default="", help="note body text")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note")
+    p.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("edit", help="change a note's title and/or body")
+    p.add_argument("id", type=int)
+    p.add_argument("-t", "--title", default=None)
+    p.add_argument("-b", "--body", default=None)
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("search", help="search titles and bodies")
+    p.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def run(
+    argv: list[str] | None = None,
+    out: TextIO | None = None,
+    err: TextIO | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    """Run the CLI with argv (defaults to sys.argv) and return an exit code."""
+    out = out or sys.stdout
+    err = err or sys.stderr
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
+
+    path = args.file or default_store_path()
+    store = NoteStore(path)
+
+    try:
+        if args.command == "add":
+            note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+            print(f"added note {note.id}", file=out)
+
+        elif args.command == "list":
+            notes = store.all_notes()
+            if not notes:
+                print("no notes", file=out)
+            for n in notes:
+                print(_format_note(n), file=out)
+
+        elif args.command == "show":
+            print(_format_note(store.get(args.id), full=True), file=out)
+
+        elif args.command == "edit":
+            if args.title is None and args.body is None:
+                print("error: nothing to edit; pass --title and/or --body", file=err)
+                return 2
+            store.update(args.id, title=args.title, body=args.body)
+            print(f"updated note {args.id}", file=out)
+
+        elif args.command == "delete":
+            store.delete(args.id)
+            print(f"deleted note {args.id}", file=out)
+
+        elif args.command == "search":
+            matches = store.search(args.query)
+            if not matches:
+                print("no matches", file=out)
+            for n in matches:
+                print(_format_note(n), file=out)
+
+    except NoteNotFoundError:
+        print(f"error: no note with id {args.id}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 2
+
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    sys.exit(run())

+"""JSON-file-backed storage for notes."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+def _now() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str = ""
+    created: str = field(default_factory=_now)
+    updated: str = field(default_factory=_now)
+
+
+class NoteStore:
+    """Stores notes in a JSON file. Missing files are treated as empty."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+        self._notes: dict[int, Note] = {}
+        self._load()
+
+    # -- persistence -------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _load(self) -> None:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return
+        raw = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") or "[]")
+        self._notes = {n["id"]: Note(**n) for n in raw}
+
+    def _save(self) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        data = json.dumps(
+            [asdict(n) for n in sorted(self._notes.values(), key=lambda n: n.id)],
+            indent=2,
+        )
+        # Write atomically so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt the file.
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            fh.write(data + "\n")
+        os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+
+    # -- operations --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _next_id(self) -> int:
+        return max(self._notes, default=0) + 1
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        """Create a note. Raises ValueError if the title is blank."""
+        if not title.strip():
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        note = Note(id=self._next_id(), title=title.strip(), body=body)
+        self._notes[note.id] = note
+        self._save()
+        return note
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        """Return the note with the given id. Raises NoteNotFoundError."""
+        try:
+            return self._notes[note_id]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id) from None
+
+    def all_notes(self) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return all notes sorted by id."""
+        return sorted(self._notes.values(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return notes whose title or body contains query (case-insensitive)."""
+        q = query.lower()
+        return [
+            n for n in self.all_notes() if q in n.title.lower() or q in n.body.lower()
+        ]
+
+    def update(
+        self, note_id: int, title: str | None = None, body: str | None = None
+    ) -> Note:
+        """Change a note's title and/or body. Raises NoteNotFoundError or ValueError."""
+        note = self.get(note_id)
+        if title is not None:
+            if not title.strip():
+                raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+            note.title = title.strip()
+        if body is not None:
+            note.body = body
+        note.updated = _now()
+        self._save()
+        return note
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> None:
+        """Remove a note. Raises NoteNotFoundError if it does not exist."""
+        self.get(note_id)
+        del self._notes[note_id]
+        self._save()
